$comment: The Realistic world (docs/proposals/REALISTIC_WORLD.md, phase R2; owner 2026-11-11: "the seed should determine tectonic plates, rain shadow, ground/rock materials, etc."): the seed does the placing. `tectonics.plates` 1: each face's own plate layout from its face seed (shared/worldgen/plates.json) decides land and sea (continental plates land, oceanic sea; since 0.61 the plates run out to the rim, a continent ending there in a shelf, only the outer band always sea), and every boundary adds its kind's and its plates' kinds' landforms by rule (plates.json `uplift.pairs`) (ranges on a subducting boundary's overriding side with a trench before them, collision ranges where two continents meet, rifts on divergent boundaries, little on transforms), with arcs of dormant cones on the overriding side and hotspot chains older along the plate's motion (plates.json `uplift`). No hand-placed boundary, arc or chain. `tectonics.climate` 1 (R3): the face seed's latitude band, its prevailing wind (trade winds, westerlies or polar easterlies) and the rain marched along it over the seed's mountains on a coarse grid (shared/worldgen/climate.json), feeding the rivers' discharge: big rivers on a range's windward side, a dry lee. `biomes` (R4): the default biome (the fallback where nothing fits) and every preset, unchanged (no per-world tuning: a bare name each; the cold desert and the tropical rainforest since §7 q9 fill the climates R4 left to the default), chosen by climate alone, Whittaker-style: each preset's `where` in °C (`celsius`) and annual rain in mm (`rain`) read the climate's temperature and its rain marched again over the eroded map (climate.json `biomes`), so a cold band may have no desert and a warm one no tundra. The old-growth forest (WORK_QUEUE item 32) where it is cool (6–13 °C) and very wet (2200 mm and more). Rocks from plate history (R5): each column's setting on the face's plates picks its rock stack (rocks.json `plateProvinces`: arc cones on andesite, hotspot islands on shield basalt, collision cores and range crests on granite and schist, the accreted strip by a trench on limestone, rifts and quiet interiors on sandstone), the noise's provinces elsewhere; the soils weather from that rock by climate (vegetation.json rockSoils). Offered in the New world form as Realistic since R6 (`newWorld`, with its Sky preset under More options); still a test world in that its seeds' terrain may change between releases (owner, §7 q7: its hashes in shared/worldgen/golden/realistic-hashes.txt updated with a note). Steps by geology (WORK_QUEUE item 15, 0.57.0; owner, 2026-11-12: "I like stepped terrain but it should be system driven not across the whole realistic world"): `cliffs` 0 turns the default terrain's global terrace volume (volume.json `cliffs`) off, and `geology.shaping.strength` 1 maps the ground through each column's rock stack (rocks.json), so it steps where the rock's jointing says: `bedded` sedimentary stacks (the basins' red beds, the rifts' fill, the accreted limestone, the cores' schist) into a wall and a tread every `bed` m, `vertical` volcanics (the arcs' andesite, the hotspots' basalt) into columns, `massive` granite (the collision and range cores) unstepped; the mesas and scarps come from `geology.erosion` (strength 1) in the arid sedimentary biomes that opt in (red rock mesa, badlands), and soils by rock and climate cover the rest. Or play it at ?worldgen=test:realistic. Prototype content.
